ACTION=A2
The pedestrian is crossing the ego vehicle's path at a forward distance of 24.4 meters. Given the ego vehicle's initial speed of 50 kph (approx. 13.9 m/s), the time to reach the conflict point is approximately 1.75 seconds. The pedestrian, moving at 1.6 m/s from a lateral position of -4.0 m, will be in the critical path during this interval. An immediate hard stop (A0) is unnecessary as there is sufficient distance to decelerate smoothly, but maintaining speed (A1) or proceeding (A3/A4) would result in a collision. Therefore, moderate braking (A2) is the appropriate action to ensure safety.
